content: Both candidates are the same molecule, so this is pure mutation with no crossover available. Where is the headroom? jnk3 here is 0.07 and across everything I have scored jnk3 moves in steps of about 0.03, while QED and the SA term move in steps of 0.1-0.2 - so the frontier is set by drug-likeness, not by activity. The current ceiling is QED 0.875 plus SA-term 0.859; getting SA down toward 1.8 and QED toward 0.90 is worth more than another 0.03 of jnk3. The methanesulfonyl azetidine (atoms 0-6 and 21) is what costs both: 136 Da of saturated sulfonamide, 2 rotatable bonds, TPSA 95, and it is the reason SA sits at 2.27. It contributes no aryl-NH linkage of its own. Atom 7 is the exocyclic amide carbonyl and the 7-6 bond is non-ring, so I replace the whole azetidine-sulfonamide with a plain phenyl, giving N-[4-(1H-pyrazol-3-yl)phenyl]benzamide at ~263 Da. The anilide NH and the pendant pyrazole - the two features that earned the 0.07 - are both untouched, while TPSA drops to about 70, rotatable bonds to 3, and SA should fall under 1.9.
